name: Fithel

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero and a wise judge
settled the quarrels of the Fianna
served king Cormac Mac Airt at Tara

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fithel also appears as Fitheal, Fiothal, and Fithil. Irish tradition calls him a hero and a wise judge, a Brehon. He settled the quarrels of the Fianna, the warriors who followed his brother Fionn Mac Cumhaill. Later he left that band to give counsel to Cormac Mac Airt, king of Tara.

okr.objective: Fithel is the Irish hero and Brehon who judged the quarrels of the Fianna.
key_results: Fithel appears under the names Fitheal, Fiothal, and Fithil.
He was a wise judge, a Brehon of the old tradition.
He settled the quarrels of the Fianna.
He later served king Cormac Mac Airt at Tara.
